item.title: Zipli - Rescuing surplus food at scale
item.description:
Project Overview

Zipli is a platform designed to rescue surplus food at scale, connecting food donors with recipients to reduce waste and fight hunger.

Key Features

  • Surplus Food Matching: Intelligent matching system connecting donors with recipients
  • Scale Operations: Built to handle large volumes of food rescue operations
  • Real-Time Coordination: Efficient logistics and coordination for food pickup and delivery
  • Impact Tracking: Metrics and reporting to measure food waste reduction
